description: Apply a batch of graph edits (add/update/remove nodes, connect/disconnect edges) atomically to the stored flowSpec. Preferred over individual calls for multi-step edits; validate afterwards.

fields.description: Nested node payload fields, in camelCase or snake_case. Objects merge, arrays replace, null clears. Use this for generate.target, assetSetSettings, process configs and exportPolicy. Do not include the node-kind wrapper. Manifest items require update_asset_set_plan.

op.description: Edit kind; remaining fields are the same names as the single-edit tools.

sourcePortType.description: Typed FLOW_PORT_* output enum required for asset-set connections; copy from the canonical graph contract.

targetPortType.description: Typed FLOW_PORT_* input enum required for asset-set connections.

sessionId.description: Persisted flow session id (flow_session_…) from create_asset_flow or list_asset_flows.

name: apply_flow_edits
